purpose: Post-hoc development sensitivity isolating training frequency weighting; not full raw-response versus mean-response comparison.
training_policy: Repeat each eligible training cell mean by its original public row count. Not reconstruction of raw within-cell response variability or independent replicates.
external_sources: None. These blocks are drawn from two existing public datasets from related research groups.
test_policy: Common-condition complete grids within each source and experimental series; all rows of held-out candidates excluded from training, including unscored incomplete grids.
model_selection: Fixed parameters for this development pilot; no model or feature selection using test loss. Final tuned analysis remains separate.
feature_policy: Six directly reported shared descriptors. Source-coded nondetection values such as N=0 remain source encodings, not established true zeros. No final concentration, source identity, or predictor computed by our pipeline from test responses enters the model. Initial concentrations remain as released; no nominal-grid snapping. Their experimental acquisition logs were not independently recovered.
response: Mass-normalized reported adsorption amount at recorded contact time (mg/g); kinetic qt remains annotated, not relabeled equilibrium qe. No qmax. Competitive IBU source converted from umol/g using factor 0.20628.
scaling: Training-only standardization over cell means repeated by released record counts. Test cells and means unchanged.
primary_loss: max observed capacity minus expected observed capacity of uniformly selected prediction maximizers
baseline: Uniform candidate selection within the identical condition; expected loss computed exactly
ties: Prediction tie absolute tolerance 1e-12; observed ties use recorded values. This is not experimental uncertainty.
aggregation: First mean conditions within series; mean series within source; never count multiple series as independent studies. Report pollutant tasks separately.
known_limits: Source-related experimental releases, unresolved physical batch independence, uncertain repeated-row identities and absent original replicate logs. Corrected-label/time/unit mappings and aggregation need sensitivity analysis before manuscript use. CBZ currently has one reviewed source and is not model-evaluable.
